findings.description: The crossed-arm pose contains three hands: fingers on the upper arm at screen left, a hand at the central sleeve cuff, and another set of fingers beneath the elbow at screen right. The closer views make the extra hand clearly visible despite there being only two arms.

The woman's torso projects through the front windshield area, with her crossed forearms resting outside on the hood ahead of the windshield base. The side window is behind the adjacent pillar, and no opening or broken glass explains how her body passes through the windshield.
